Intro: I still remember that day. Casmir was drunk, enraged over some ridiculous bet. Throwing plates, cussing—using his hands on me as he pleased.
Usually I'd cower or beg, do anything to calm him down. But strangely, the fear I once had for him was gone. The chains of marriage no longer tied me.
I wear these clothes not out of mourning but celebration. I'm finally…free. I do not know what happened to me that day, but I am grateful for it.
It is thanks to this change of heart that I am here now, ordering from you once again. I could not be happier.
Success: Kind Chef….if only you were there when I was but a naive girl, with goodness still in me. But you came too late. I have found happiness my own way.
Fail: Kind Chef….if only you were there when I was but a naive girl, with goodness still in me. But you came too late. I have found happiness my own way.
Reject: I do not regret killing him, kind Chef. I truly enjoy the time we spent together. Thank you for listening to me.
